Statics live in the enemies list, so their keyframe animation (*_anim_add) is advanced every frame by CutScene::process (Transform::Update(dt)); no explicit animation state. No parked ships (max 0) although one slot [4096,0,0] exists. CutScene::process uses index 10 for this station (vs 8 here).

entries.name: bar_vossk
entries.notes: Bar = Level(mode 4), CutScene(4). Statics: PlayerStatic(-1, AEGeometry(id), 0,0,0), no rotation. All enemies-list geometries get Transform::Update(dt) every frame in CutScene::process, so *_anim meshes loop. Only 2 statics (3rd table slot is 0xffff). Fog: FogSetParameter(0x2601, 0, 5000.0 (0x459c4000), 1.0, 0x11e0cff) + FogEnable. bar_vossk_alpha and bar_vossk_bot_a/b/c_anim_alpha FBX have no resource id and no code. CutScene::process has a Vossk branch that animates CutScene+0x30/+0x34 every 20 s / 22 s, but those pointers are only set for Terran (dead/unfinished).
